question: In a certain code language, SUCCESS is written as HVXDVTH and LOVELY is written as OPEFOZ. How will EXTREME be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

SUCCESS is written as HVXDVTH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4788cc661bee460c7c7133604d85c2305a042d0b5b0511d7cad73466cc0b12b6.png] 

And,

LOVELY is written as OPEFOZ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45af7fcf99b309a770734024349a1e012cdfd34da32ac11cac2a68d36a05228b.png] 

Similarly,

EXTREME will be written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cfcf580854a8f2fbf4df3deb4d336c902f652e5a4d9bed1c97bcaed8426e9b8b.png] 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
